T_k: The correction encodes the rule directly as class scores: class_1 gets +1.8*x2*x5, class_0 gets -1.8*x2*x5, and class_2 gets x4^2 - 0.3, so the largest score reproduces the class_2 versus sign-of-product decision. All three scores are multiplied by 2 so they can outweigh the base model's logits without changing the boundary between them. Outputs are clipped to keep large feature values stable.
